description: Delete PracticeLobby.tsx (the catalog screen), create PracticeCompletion.tsx (encouragement screen), update onComplete prop signature on all four activity components from () => void to (scorePercent: number) => void, and rewrite PracticeActivity.tsx to route new activity IDs and accept the updated onComplete type.
steps:
UPDATE src/screens/learner/practice/ComprehensionActivity.tsx:
  - Change Props interface: onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void
  - In handleNext, replace `setPhase('done')` with `onComplete(Math.round((correctCount / questions.length) * 100))`
  - Remove the entire 'done' phase render block (the if (phase === 'done') branch with the 🎉 screen)
  - The phase state type becomes 'reading' | 'quiz' only
  - No other changes

UPDATE src/screens/learner/practice/VocabularyActivity.tsx:
  - Change Props interface: onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void
  - In handleNext, replace `setDone(true)` with `onComplete(Math.round((correctCount / vocabularyItems.length) * 100))`
  - Remove the done state and the `if (done)` render block
  - No other changes

UPDATE src/screens/learner/practice/ReadAloudActivity.tsx:
  - Change Props interface: onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void
  - The 'Tapos na akong Basahin ✓' button's onClick currently calls `() => setDone(true)`. Change it to `() => onComplete(-1)`
  - Remove the done state and the `if (done)` render block
  - No other changes

UPDATE src/screens/learner/practice/WordPracticeActivity.tsx:
  - Change Props interface: onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void
  - In handleNext, replace `setDone(true)` with `onComplete(Math.round((correctCount / wordPracticeItems.length) * 100))`
  - Remove the done state and the `if (done)` render block
  - No other changes

REWRITE src/screens/learner/practice/PracticeActivity.tsx:
  - Props: { activityId: string; onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void; onBack: () => void }
  - Keep the switch statement with cases: practice-001 → ComprehensionActivity, practice-002 → VocabularyActivity, practice-003 → ReadAloudActivity, practice-004 → WordPracticeActivity
  - Add cases for practice-005 → ComprehensionActivity, practice-006 → VocabularyActivity, practice-007 → ComprehensionActivity (level 3 uses comprehension content; these IDs share the same content as practice-001/002 for MVP)
  - Keep the default unknown-ID fallback unchanged except update its onComplete call to `() => onComplete(0)` to satisfy the type

CREATE src/screens/learner/PracticeCompletion.tsx:
  Props: { learnerName: string; activityTitle: string; scorePercent: number; onKeepPracticing: () => void; onBackToDashboard: () => void }
  
  Layout structure (all inline styles, no Tailwind classes):
  - Outer wrapper div: minHeight '100svh', background 'var(--talas-paper)', display flex, flexDirection column, alignItems center, justifyContent center, padding clamp(12px, 4vw, 24px)
  - Inner content div: width 'min(480px, 100%)', margin '0 auto', display flex, flexDirection column, alignItems center, gap 20px, textAlign center
  - FrogMascot size={120}
  - h2 'Mahusay! 🎉': fontFamily Comfortaa, fontSize 28px, fontWeight 700, color var(--talas-green), margin 0
  - p 'Natapos mo ang {activityTitle}.': fontFamily Quicksand, fontSize 16px, color var(--talas-charcoal), margin 0
  - Conditional score badge (only if scorePercent >= 0): div with background var(--talas-buttercream), borderRadius 16px, border '1px solid #FFE08A', padding '16px 32px', fontFamily Plus Jakarta Sans, fontSize 24px, fontWeight 700, color var(--talas-charcoal). Show text like '80%' (use `${scorePercent}%` — but if scorePercent === -1, skip badge or show 'Tapos na! ✓')
  - Conditional encouragement text:
    if scorePercent >= 80: 'Napakahusay! Patuloy ka!' — color var(--talas-green), fontFamily Quicksand, fontSize 15px
    else if scorePercent >= 60: 'Magaling! Tuloy lang!' — color #6B7280, fontFamily Quicksand, fontSize 15px
    else if scorePercent >= 0 (i.e. < 60): 'Okay lang, subukan ulit!' — color var(--talas-coral), fontFamily Quicksand, fontSize 15px
    if scorePercent === -1: no encouragement text (read-aloud, no score)
  - 'Magpatuloy sa Pagsasanay 💪' button: width 100%, minHeight 56px, background var(--talas-green), color white, border none, borderRadius 16px, fontFamily Plus Jakarta Sans, fontSize 16px, fontWeight 700, cursor pointer → calls onKeepPracticing
  - 'Bumalik sa Dashboard' button: width 100%, minHeight 56px, background transparent, color var(--talas-green), border '2px solid var(--talas-green)', borderRadius 16px, fontFamily Plus Jakarta Sans, fontSize 14px, fontWeight 600, cursor pointer → calls onBackToDashboard
  
  Import FrogMascot from '../../components/FrogMascot'
acceptance_criteria: All four activity components have onComplete: (scorePercent: number) => void in their Props interface
No activity component has an internal 'done' state screen — they call onComplete directly when the learner finishes
PracticeCompletion.tsx renders FrogMascot, the activity title, optional score badge, encouragement text, and two full-width buttons
PracticeActivity.tsx has cases for practice-001 through practice-007 and its onComplete prop accepts a number
`npm run build` passes with no TypeScript errors (App.tsx still references PracticeLobby at this point — it will be fixed in FEAT-003; FEAT-002 can be verified jointly with FEAT-003)
verification: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\ashai\TALAS after FEAT-003 is also applied (App.tsx is fixed in FEAT-003). To verify in isolation, temporarily comment out the PracticeLobby import and practice-lobby case in App.tsx, then run build.
findings: PracticeLobby.tsx was already deleted by FEAT-001 — no action needed. All four activity components updated: onComplete signature changed to (scorePercent: number) => void, internal 'done' state and done-screen render blocks removed. ComprehensionActivity calls onComplete(Math.round((correctCount/questions.length)*100)) on last question. VocabularyActivity and WordPracticeActivity follow the same pattern. ReadAloudActivity calls onComplete(-1) directly from the 'Tapos na' button. PracticeActivity.tsx rewritten with cases for practice-001 through practice-007 (005→ComprehensionActivity, 006→VocabularyActivity, 007→ComprehensionActivity sharing MVP content); default fallback calls onComplete(0). PracticeCompletion.tsx created with FrogMascot(size=120), conditional score badge (skipped for scorePercent === -1), conditional encouragement text (green >=80, gray 60-79, coral <60, none for -1), Keep Practicing and Back to Dashboard full-width buttons. One additional change in App.tsx: handleActivityComplete signature updated to (_scorePercent: number) => void to satisfy the new PracticeActivity onComplete type (FEAT-001 had left it as () => void which would fail TS type-check). Build passed clean (0 TS errors). Committed as f486b5d.
